svg.desc: Two lanes explain the remaining token-release rows without adding project milestones. F08.4e.7.d.2 committed-original packet, commit and effects verification is source-landed in b7be5cbdf2ef75eda606b025032943dc0812bcb9. F08.4e.7.d.4 durable exact outcome is source-landed in 73a7f82b7aacdb5f4e323715ccde1c264330d81a: separate root storage authorization, independent checkpoint and first-exact outcome retention. F08.4e.7.d.6 uncertain-outcome recovery is source-landed in e49e14ec3039448af9f84bd0f21b20539046adba: fresh root recovery authority, historical original evidence and unchanged outcome readback around live private token opening. Row 15 exact committed-original release is closed in source with all 6/6 diagnostics landed. Root bootstrap and key delivery 16.1 is source-landed in e6fa55c4160fe8058b04583e165d3253315419d1: root-selected live/recovery bootstrap, original-bound resource intake and actual owner construction. Isolated cold service 16.2 and bounded private transport 16.3 are source-landed in 4097896b3d0eabd735a7deb711b5c884b7c98363: fixed root delivery, same-process original lifetime, one finite exchange and profile-bound private framing. Independent response verifier 16.4 is source-landed in abce0bb6f70ef9eb87d980ca9f0fd788fb6e3fb0: fresh root client authority, original server/intent/proof admission, exact expected outcome, request echo and token commitment checks. Authorized private handoff 16.5 is source-landed in 5719d50b9d05de6420286ac52a4ac3fc285c83c0. Row 16 cold private handoff has five landed, zero active and zero open diagnostics: F08.4e.7.e.1 root bootstrap and key delivery; e.2 isolated cold service; e.3 bounded private transport; e.4 independent response verifier; e.5 authorized private handoff. Every task has a visible ID, name and written status as well as color; no hover or internal SVG link is needed to understand its status. Criteria and complete evidence remain in the linked source ledger. These eleven nested diagnostics are not eleven new project milestones or effort estimates. Parent token release remains 16/16 source-landed, 0 in progress and 0 open; production acceptance remains 0/6 verified. Independent original response verification is source-landed, not deployed delivery, latest-state witness proof or later public/portal permission. Source only, unbuilt, unexecuted and unprovisioned; no deployed service or current-session claim.
